findings.scenario: Compare parent is reserved for Arm A, Arm B, and an evaluator. D6U CASes the unused evaluator offered|queued lease to cancelled|expired (parent stays held, no hierarchy amount movement). Arm A terminals and D6 does claimed->released (no-op if already terminal). Arm B had uncertain dispatch, so its lease is reconciliation-hold; D6 therefore leaves that lease in reconciliation-hold and CASes the parent held->reconciliation-hold. D7 is the only legal reservation-hold and lease-hold exit, but its lease column allows only already-released-with-terminal-receipt (no-op) or reconciliation-hold->released. The evaluator lease is cancelled|expired, which has no D7 transition (`expired|cancelled|released -> no transition`). Strict execution rejects D7 (parent money and Arm B capacity stuck forever) or an implementer invents a second hold-exit / reopens the cancelled slot. The same pairing arises if an unclaimed arm was cancelled while a sibling lease remained in reconciliation-hold.
findings.remediation: Give D7 the same already-terminal lease set as D6: each associated lease is already released|cancelled|expired with bound terminal or UnusedCompareComponentProofV1 hash (no-op, do not reopen) or reconciliation-hold->released in this CAS, still only with bound terminal hashes plus owner-reconcile. Keep reconciliation-hold->released legal only in D7.

audit.proof_assessment: v8 is not faithful to these bytes: it still describes D2 as claimed|reconciliation-hold->released, D6 as unable to join already-released siblings, and unused proofs as non-CAS records. Current text already makes D2 claimed->released only, D6 no-op on released|cancelled|expired plus park-parent on any lease reconciliation-hold, and D6U an atomic unused-proof CAS that binds priorComponentStateRevision and rejects later claim. Those closures are real. v8 is therefore not authority that the old holes remain, and it missed the residual composition hole: D7 was not given D6/D6U's cancelled|expired no-op, so exclusive D7 cannot finish a parked compare parent.
residual_risks: D1 prior-offered forbids reading QueueStateV1 while queue-full offered->cancelled must observe depth; two offered admissions can race maximumQueueDepth unless the offered->queued CAS is the sole depth gate.

Capacity claimed->released requires a terminal receipt hash but the general capacity paragraph does not bind that receipt's segmentId/manifestHash/jobId to CapacityLeaseV1; D-rows say this-segment, the lease state machine does not.
Reservation expiresAt has no D-code; expiry is told not to silently release an ambiguous hold, but the positive transition is unspecified.
D6U restates parent/hierarchy amount no-op but does not restate queued ticket removal/depth decrement; it relies on the general queued->cancelled rule.
In-memory fixtures still cannot prove crash-safe CAS, replay/attach, or durable reconciliation.
